data.long_meaning: The name Nimi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nimitta’, meaning 'that which is adorned, decorated or an indicator'. In Hindu mythology, Nimi is a celestial nymph and a wife of the sage Vedavyasa. The name Nimi carries the meaning “Adorned, Decorated” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nimi usually hope their child will grow to embody adorned, decorated and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimi total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
